title: Handle Rust failure explicitly
why: unwrap terminates the process when a Result or Option is not successful.
suggestion: Propagate the error, handle each variant, or document why failure is impossible.
limitations: The rule uses masked source tokens and does not perform Rust type resolution.

Conventional test modules, including files containing zero-hash raw strings, lint-allowed items, literal or fully escaped regex construction, regex capture group zero, guarded Option and collection access, infallible formatting into a proven String, literal parsing, documented checked-arithmetic panic contracts, generated catalog invariants, and documented local invariants are excluded.
